events.text: I made the webhook handling monotonic by event.created with a minimal app-code change: added teams.stripe_event_created to the Drizzle schema, created that column in Postgres via psql, passed event.created from the webhook route into handleSubscriptionChange, and had the handler ignore any event older than the newest one already stored for that customer. The handler still updates/cancels subscriptions as before, but now older updated events cannot resurrect a canceled subscription. I then reran all five replay plans, and each ended with the correct canceled final state.
